title: Product Listing Page
description:
A Product Listing Page (also called Category Page), shows the products of a category as a grid

---

<custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

**As a** user shopping in an online store,  
**I want** to view a list of products within a specific category or filtered selection,  
**so that** I can easily browse and compare items that match my interests.

---

enrichedData.purpose: Online shoppers need a structured way to view and compare products within categories or filtered selections to find items matching their interests efficiently.
useCases: View products within a specific category as a grid
Browse and compare items that match user interests
Filter product selection based on criteria
